verdict.rationale: SolidJS's own documentation explicitly lists 'streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible' as a core SSR feature, directly matching the story. However, there is no independent or hands-on evidence specifically validating progressive hydration behavior in practice (community comments focus on other aspects like reactivity, bundle size, or SolidStart routing issues). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of progressive hydration performance, detailed docs/examples of the hydration mechanism, and benchmarks isolating hydration speed.
